title: The interferon γ pathway enhances pluripotency and X-chromosome reactivation in iPSC reprogramming
model: Mouse PaX-iCas9 NPC-to-iPSC reprogramming, genome-wide KO (~90,000 guides); FACS-sorted populations
contrast: Early vs non-pluripotent and late vs early pluripotent (1 pooled library per condition)
paper_method: MAGeCK-RRA (negative LFC), pathway over-representation of top 250 genes
paper_calls: Named activators: Fut9, Smad2/4, Pou5f1, Sox2, Smarca4, Hes1 (early); Nanog, Il6st, Dazl, Hes6/7, IFNg pathway Stat1/Jak1/Irf2/Ifngr2 (late)
barcs_calls: 73 genes (early) and 22 genes (late) at FDR 0.10; no named hit passes FDR
named_hits: All in the paper's direction; Nanog #178, Il6st #185, Hes6 #290 (late); none at FDR 0.10
verdict: BARCS recovers the direction and rough ranking of the paper's pluripotency and X-reactivation genes (Spearman 0.51-0.69 with MAGeCK) but, with the deposited one-library-per-condition counts and no controls, cannot confirm any at FDR 0.10; the IFNg pathway conclusion is a top-250 enrichment that a one-library analysis cannot reach.
